title: A Study of ZW209 in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
official: First-in-Human, Phase 1, Open-label, Multicenter Study of ZW209 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) and Other Delta-like Ligand 3 (DLL3) Expressing Cancers
summary: The purpose of this study is to find out if ZW209, an antibody designed to direct patient T cells to target and destroy DLL3 expressing cancer cells is safe and can treat participants with advanced cancers, including small cell lung cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pathologically confirmed diagnosis of small cell lung cancer (SCLC), extrapulmonary neuroendocrine cancer (EP-NEC), large cell neuroendocrine cancer (LCNEC), or Merkel cell cancer (MCC), with evidence of locally advanced (unresectable), recurrent, or metastatic disease.
* Must have measurable disease per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 as assessed by the local site investigator/radiologist.
* Adequate neurological function
* Adequate cardiac function
* Baseline oxygen saturation greater or equal to 90% without supplemental oxygen at rest.
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status score of 0 or 1.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known additional malignancy type that is progressing or has required treatment in the last year.
* Ongoing significant toxicity associated with a prior cancer therapy.
* Undergone prior allogenic tissue or solid organ transplant in last 5 years.
* Requiring more than 1 thoracocentesis (drainage of fluid around lungs) within 2 weeks of first dose of study drug.
* Acute or chronic kidney, pancreas, or liver disease.
